units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 46b">B. Bath. 46ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ שוויה</he> Ar. (read: <he>שויוהו</he>; v. <cite ref="E00882"><he>הַרְמנְיָא</he></cite>) they made him an administrator (of their property, and as such he let it out to tenants).

<cite ref="Eruvin 59a:9">Erub. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>דשכיחי גבי ק׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="E00881"><he>הרמנא</he></cite>) they are accustomed to meet at the office of the curator of the city, v. <cite ref="E00881"><he>הַרְמָנָא</he></cite>.
